cds.title: Hamilton College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research and Assessment; some page headers still read 2024-2025)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class from the Common Data Set. C1 residency rows add up to the totals (applicants 1,611 + 3,707 + 3,586 = 8,904; admits 334 + 780 + 96 = 1,210; enrolled 130 + 308 + 40 = 478). In-state means New York. International first-years: 3,586 applied, 96 admitted, 40 enrolled. The early decision figure (1,120 applications, 315 admitted) covers ED I and ED II. The waitlist is not ranked. Hamilton reported no GPA figures (C11-C12 blank); 18.41% of first-years reported class rank. SAT/ACT submission is optional: 166 first-years submitted the SAT (35%) and 64 the ACT (13%). The factor ratings (C7) are read from the position of the X marks in the PDF layout. Undergraduate enrollment (1,980) is the B1 'Total all undergraduates' figure; the nonresident count (155) is the B2 degree-seeking undergraduates column.

cost.notes: Full-year first-year costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5): tuition $75,210, required fees $750, on-campus food and housing $19,290 (housing $10,540 + meal plan $8,750). Estimated expenses: books and supplies $800, transportation $500 and other expenses $1,000 (other costs shown = transportation + other). No total is shown because the CDS does not give one. The H6 nonresident-aid counts and dollar amounts are blank in the CDS; it ticks institutional need-based aid as available to nonresidents.
